meta.note: Software variant: same cream, ink and brick identity, flattened for product UI. Adds a dark theme, state colors and a UI sans.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind panels. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, inputs, menus, dialogs, table body. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: sidebar, table header, code blocks, disabled fields. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of any `surface` row, item or secondary button; neutral badges. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill, progress track, off-switch track, cover tiles. Text on it: `fg` only.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on every `bg` and `surface-*` token. 14.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, table headers, placeholders. Reads 5.0:1 or better on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-hover`; never on `surface-active`.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast, so never carries information on its own.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (1px). Decorative: do not use on controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes, menus, dialogs). 3:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brick. Primary buttons, selected checkbox and switch, active tab underline, progress fill, focus ring. Paired with `primary-fg`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`, `primary-hover` and `primary-active`. 5.5:1 in light, 5.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected nav item, brand-tinted badge. Text on it: `fg`, `primary-text`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Brick as text, links and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `primary-subtle`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring color: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the big slab on the cover. Flips with the theme. Text on it: `inverse-fg`.

tokens.name: inverse-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-bg`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success solid: filled badges, progress, switch confirmations. Teal-leaning so it stays off the red-green axis. Paired with `success-fg`.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `success`.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of success alerts, toasts and badges. Text on it: `fg`, `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and 1px borders on `bg`, `surface` and `success-subtle`. 5.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning solid: filled badges only. Too light to mark anything on cream; use `warning-text` for icons, borders and text. Paired with `warning-fg`.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warning`. Ink in both themes: amber never takes cream text.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of warning alerts, toasts and badges. Text on it: `fg`, `warning-text`.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and 1px borders on `bg`, `surface` and `warning-subtle`. 6.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger solid: destructive buttons, filled error badges. Crimson, cooler than the brick `primary`; always shown with an icon and a word. Paired with `danger-fg`.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `danger`.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of error alerts, toasts, badges and invalid fields. Text on it: `fg`, `danger-text`.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text, icons, invalid-field borders and 1px borders on `bg`, `surface` and `danger-subtle`. 5.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info solid: filled badges, progress. Steel blue, used only for neutral system messages. Paired with `info-fg`.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `info`.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground of info alerts, toasts and badges. Text on it: `fg`, `info-text`.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text, icons and 1px borders on `bg`, `surface` and `info-subtle`. 5.0:1 or better.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title, once per screen, wrapped in brick brackets. Rubik One has a single weight: never bold.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section title inside a page, empty-state titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Deploys run after every merge to main.
styles.usage: Default UI text: descriptions, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, tab labels, names in lists, alert titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Welcome back. Three deployments need review.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, small buttons, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps, helper and error text under fields, in `fg-muted`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Sidebar and menu group labels, uppercase.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Commit hashes, file names, keyboard keys.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers, IDs, versions and durations in tables and metrics. Right-align numbers, tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its text in alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu padding, gap between tabs, icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between inline controls; badge padding x.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and fields in a row; table cell padding x; small button padding x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding x (md); card and alert padding; gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large button padding x; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog and card body padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; overlay padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space under a page title block.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, kbd keys, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts, toasts, menus, tooltips. Matches CroustyLab `radius-brutal-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, sidebar. Matches CroustyLab `radius-brutal-md`.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches, progress bars, status dots. Never on buttons.

shadow.note: Flat system: nothing at rest has a shadow. Only floating layers carry one, and it stays hard (no blur), the CroustyLab signature.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips and toasts floating above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and drawers.

border.note: Edges are 1px hairlines, not the 2px ink strokes of the portfolio.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every edge: controls, cards, tables, dividers.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Selected card edge and the indeterminate emphasis; the one place the 2px CroustyLab stroke survives.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline, solid `focus`, offset 2px.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and inputs in toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of large buttons; touch targets.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Menu items, nav items, dense table rows.

tokens.name: row-md
tokens.usage: Default table row.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Phosphor bold icon inside buttons, badges and menus.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Phosphor bold icon in alerts, toasts and nav.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Width of the app sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the collapsed, icon-only sidebar.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: Default dialog width.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width of a page.
